food.hero_title: The restaurant POS that powers your entire operation
food.hero_desc: From front of house to the kitchen, manage orders, payments, menus, and more with one intuitive platform built for modern restaurants.
food.banner_title: All the tools you need front of house, in the kitchen, and more.
food.banner_desc: Foody brings together everything your restaurant needs: point of sale, QR ordering, kitchen management, analytics, and payments. All in one platform, all in sync.
food.features_title: Tools that work to transform your restaurant business
food.feat1_title: Launch your website and take orders online.
food.feat1_desc: Build a branded website for your restaurant and start accepting online orders with pickup and delivery options. No monthly software fees, no commissions on your orders.
food.feat2_title: Scan supplier deliveries with AI-powered OCR.
food.feat2_desc: Just snap a photo of your delivery voucher. Our AI reads printed and handwritten documents, even in Hebrew, and extracts quantities and prices automatically. Stock levels update in real time with low-stock alerts. No manual data entry, no paperwork.
food.feat3_title: Know your food costs down to the last ingredient.
food.feat3_desc: Foody calculates your real food cost per dish by linking recipes to supplier prices. Track margins, spot waste, and make smarter purchasing decisions from your dashboard.
food.feat4_title: Offer self-service ordering with QR codes.
food.feat4_desc: Guests scan, browse, and order from their phone. No app download needed. Orders go directly to the kitchen, reducing wait times and freeing up your staff.
food.tools_title: Even more tools for your restaurant
food.tools_desc: From loyalty programs to inventory tracking, Foody has everything you need to run a smarter restaurant.
food.tool1_desc: Reward returning customers and drive repeat visits with built-in loyalty programs and digital gift cards.
food.tool2_desc: Track ingredients, get low-stock alerts, and manage suppliers. Never run out of what you need during service.
food.tool3_desc: Generate detailed sales reports, end-of-day summaries, and invoices automatically. Everything you need for accounting in one place.
food.cta_desc: Join hundreds of restaurants already using Foody to streamline their operations.

hero.title: Power your business with Foody Pos.
hero.lead: Accept payments, manage sales, and run your business in-store or online with one platform.
hero.cta_secondary: Contact our sales team for help getting started →
hero.compliance: AI-powered POS built for modern restaurants

sell.title: Start selling wherever you want in minutes.
sell.card1_desc: Generate revenue anywhere with QR code ordering, online takeaway, and seamless digital payments.
sell.card2_title: Save time with one flexible system.
sell.card2_desc: Get started with our iPad POS for restaurants, cafes, or any type of food business. Add hardware as you grow.
sell.card3_desc: Accept all payment types in-store, online, or on the go. Payments are processed by PayPlus, a fully certified provider in Israel (PCI DSS compliant, ISO 27001, registered with the Israel Tax Authority).

qr.title: Accept QR orders directly from your guests' phones.
qr.desc: Let your guests scan, browse the menu, and order from their own phone with Foody's QR ordering system. No app download needed.

tap.title: Accept contactless payments directly from your iPhone or Android phone.
tap.desc: Accept contactless cards and digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone and Tap to Pay on Android.

manage.title: Manage everything from one place.
manage.desc: With all your orders, customers, inventory, and more in one place, you can easily manage your day-to-day and plan for the future with peace of mind.
manage.card1_desc: Your Foody Dashboard is where it all happens. Get advanced insights and reports on online and in-store sales. Included with all Foody plans.
manage.card2_desc: Foody runs on iPad, iPhone, Android, and Mac. Your orders, menus, and analytics sync in real-time so you can manage your business from anywhere.

pricing.section_description: Pick the plan that fits your restaurant. Upgrade anytime as you grow.
pricing.premium_note: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
pricing.small_print: All plans include cloud hosting, real-time WebSocket sync, and multilingual support. Prices may vary based on monthly order volume. Hardware (iPad, printer) sold separately.

footer.tagline: Built for Restaurants in Israel. Powered by Intelligence.

contact.page_subtitle: Answer a few questions and get in touch with our team right away. We'll help you find the right tools for your business.
contact.modal_subtitle: Tell us about your restaurant and we'll get back to you within 24 hours at mickael@foody-pos.co.il
contact.form_ipad: Do you already have an iPad?
contact.form_ipad_note: An iPad is required for the POS. We also sell iPads separately if you need one.
contact.form_printer: Do you want to use receipt / ticket printing?
contact.form_printer_sub: Do you have a POS printer?
contact.form_printer_note: A POS printer is needed to test printing during the demo. We also sell printers separately if you need one.

food_overview.hero_title: Incredibly intuitive payment software for restaurants
food_overview.hero_desc: Whether you run a bar, a full-service restaurant, a quick-service spot, or a multi-concept venue, streamline your order flow and keep more of your revenue. Get the POS solution your team can learn in minutes.
food_overview.what_desc: Payment processing, table management, and stock control are just the beginning. The best restaurant payment software connects your kitchen and your front-of-house while letting you focus on the guest experience.
food_overview.why_desc: Why use poorly designed, unreliable tools? Simplify your operations and say goodbye to pen and paper. With Foody POS for restaurants, enjoy payment processing, menu management, online ordering, and much more.
food_overview.pain_1: Poor communication between kitchen and front-of-house
food_overview.old_way_title: Say goodbye to the old ways
food_overview.benefit_1_desc: by easily accepting online takeaway and delivery orders.
food_overview.benefit_2_desc: to use our intuitive restaurant software with ease.
food_overview.benefit_3_desc: with orders and payments processed from one system.
food_overview.benefit_4_desc: with comprehensive data that helps your restaurant stand out.
food_overview.benefit_6_desc: your menus, employees, and other aspects of your business across multiple locations.
food_overview.concepts_desc: Foody adapts to all types of restaurant concepts. See how.
food_overview.start_title: Get started now or after work.
food_overview.start_card1_desc: After your free 14-day trial, keep your Foody Premium plan for ₪799/month + payment processing fees. Or choose the Foody Starter plan and pay only for payment processing.
food_overview.start_card2_desc: You can purchase the devices that best fit your concept's needs from the Foody store. You can also repurpose existing devices.
food_overview.start_card2_note: Contact our team to learn about hardware offers.
food_overview.carousel_pos_desc: to manage orders, tables, and payments from one screen.
food_overview.carousel_qr_desc: for click and collect or dine-in self-ordering.
food_overview.carousel_kds_desc: to organize and track orders in real time.
food_overview.carousel_tap_desc: to process orders and contactless payments on mobile.
food_overview.carousel_dashboard_desc: to track sales, inventory, and performance at a glance.
food_overview.concept_ghost_desc: Manage pickup and delivery orders from a single dashboard. No dining room needed, just your kitchen and Foody POS.
food_overview.concept_counter_desc: Speed up service with quick order entry, integrated payments, and real-time kitchen display for counter-style restaurants.
food_overview.concept_fullservice_desc: Table management, dine-in ordering, and course-by-course service. Everything your front-of-house team needs.

whatsapp.title: Engage your customers on WhatsApp
whatsapp.desc: As an official META technology partner, Foody lets every restaurant use their own WhatsApp Business account to communicate directly with customers, automatically.
whatsapp.use2: Digital receipts sent straight to WhatsApp
whatsapp.use3: Promote new menus, seasonal dishes & special offers
